title: Dispatch: olc5.12 close Sol S4/S7 residuals + Ebony Fly evidence (.12.7/.12.8/.12.9) (attempt 4, Sonnet)
description:
Close the residuals that olc5.12.6 left open on Sol r1 findings S4 and S7 (read bd show eshyra-olc5.12.5 S4 and S7, eshyra-olc5.12.6 notes, and eshyra-olc5.12.7, .12.8, .12.9). Branch cut from eshyra-olc5.12 @ 6a99d7e8.

A (.12.7, S4 cascades): every grant-bound effect ending must anchor its grant-ended cooldown at the EFFECTIVE termination minute. Today finalizeEnd (packages/core/src/state/activeEffects.ts, the grant-ended block) passes the deadline only for reason 'expired'; cascaded endings (an expiry or life event at minute T that cascades into ending a grant-bound effect - e.g. concentration owner removed/incapacitated/killed by another effect's expiry, linked actor removal, owner-effect cleanup) use the advance endpoint. Enumerate every cascade path into finalizeEnd (grep its callers and the cleanup/cascade helpers), thread an optional event minute through the cascade context (FinalizeEndInput / EffectMutationContext or the cleanup plan) so a cascade inherits the triggering event's minute, and have the grant-ended anchor use it. Also make sure a clock advance that crosses that availableAt settles the item reset within the same advance (as S4 partition requires). Permanent evidence: extend the S4 partition invariance test to at least one real cascade path for the Ring (one large advance == advances split at the cascade minute and at availableAt).

B (.12.8, S7 audit): enumerate EVERY caller that can reach finalizeEnd or item-mechanics lookups through a terminal/cascade path (world-time advance, round/turn boundary, encounter closure, HP tools, death saves, stabilize, conditions, rest, end_effect, refresh, any orchestrator tool) and make each forward the campaign CampaignRulesPackResolver; list them in completion notes with file:line. Permanent evidence: a generalized add-on-stack parity test parameterized over the terminal entry points (each ends an anchored Ring grant on a base+add-on stack and must succeed with the anchor scheduled), not one example per path hand-written.

C (.12.9): Ebony Fly grant uses statBlockRef stat-block:giant-fly (no creature:giant-fly in the pack). Find how a combatant built from a stat block is represented (rules_ref of the combatant) and add the acceptance test for the ebony-fly variant; if no combatant can carry a stat-block ref, stop and report.

Do not change unrelated behaviour, do not weaken tests. No pack regeneration expected; if needed, follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md. Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: cascade path table (path -> minute source), resolver caller table, test names, verify result. Close .12.7/.12.8/.12.9 with reasons if fully resolved.
notes:
Dispatched as Claude Sonnet 5.5 Agent (Haiku flagged the cascade-time threading as beyond existing machinery; user authorized Sonnet if needed). Worktree .worktrees/eshyra-olc5.12.10 from eshyra-olc5.12 @ 6a99d7e8.
COMPLETION (Sonnet 5.5). Commit a3943b51 on eshyra-olc5.12.10; not pushed, no PR, no beads:sync. verify:worktree exit 0 (364 files passed, 2 skipped; 6855 tests passed, 3 skipped).
A (.12.7) CASCADE PATHS -> MINUTE SOURCE. Mechanism: optional EffectMutationContext.eventElapsedMinutes (activeEffects.ts). finalizeEnd resolves it as ctx value, else the deadline of an 'expired' ending, else the current clock, then runs cleanupOwnedState, createUncontrolledSuccessor and the grant-ended anchor under that context. expireElapsedWorldEffects sets it per row to the row's deadline. Cascade paths into finalizeEnd from inside finalizeEnd: (1) cleanupOwnedState -> removeProjection actor -> removeCombatantFromPlay (encounterCombatants.ts) -> breakCombatantConcentration -> finalizeEnd: threaded; (2) same via removeCampaignActorFromPlay (spreads input): threaded; (3) removeProjection condition -> updateCampaignActor -> updateCombatant -> breakCombatantConcentration: threaded (input types gained eventElapsedMinutes); (4) removeProjection condition on character -> removeCondition: cannot reach finalizeEnd; (5) revertProjection -> applyNaturalForm: no break call, cannot reach; (6) closeActorLinkAtZeroHp: not a cascade source from cleanup. Non-cascade callers (round expiry, turn boundary, closure, explicit end, HP/life events, replacement) run at the current clock, which is the event time, so no minute is needed. Resolver advance in same sweep: rest.ts advanceWorldTime runs expiry then resolveDueItemClockEvents, so availableAt crossing in the same advance already settles (covered by partition test).
B (.12.8) RESOLVER AUDIT. Forwarded (verified): rest.ts:216 expiry, rest.ts:657 rest advance (...input), toolRest.ts:82, actionEconomy.ts:929 settleEffectsAtTurnBoundary, encounterCombatants.ts closeCombatInstanceInTxn ~2536, removeCombatantFromPlay, updateCombatantInTxn, toolAdjustHp, toolUpdateCombatant, toolEndEffect, toolRefreshEffect, toolRemoveEffectTarget, toolResolveConcentration, toolStartEffect, toolTransitionBondedSummon, toolRecastBondedSummon, toolCloseCombatInstance, toolBeginTurn, toolSetSurprised, toolJoinCombat, toolStartEncounter, toolRecordDeathSave/toolStabilizeCharacter character branches, toolAdjustExhaustion combatant branch. GAPS FOUND AND FIXED: toolAddCondition.ts (addCondition -> breakConcentrationOnLifeEvent), toolSetSuffocation.ts both branches (character beginSuffocation/endSuffocation; combatant setCombatantSuffocation), toolAdjustExhaustion.ts character branch, toolRecordDeathSave.ts and toolStabilizeCharacter.ts combatant branches (state ctx types gained resolveRulesPack). Not reaching terminal paths (no change): toolRemoveCondition, toolSuppressEffect, toolUnsuppressEffect, toolGrantTempHp, toolUpdateClock (label only). Residual: domainMutations.addCondition's conditionImpliesIncapacitated lookup takes no resolver (pre-existing condition-record lookup, separate from item mechanics).
C (.12.9): combatant with rulesRef stat-block:giant-fly is admitted by start_encounter and grantAdmitsCreature matches it by statBlockRef; test 'binds the Ebony Fly grant to a combatant built from stat-block:giant-fly...' covers acceptance, typed 12h duration, wrong-creature refusal, expiry.
TESTS (itemGrantSummons.test.ts): 'S7 parity: <entry> ends an anchored Ring grant on the <base|base plus add-on> stack with the wait scheduled' x2 stacks x 14 entry points (end_effect, advance_time, complete long rest, djinni 0 HP, owner combatant 0 HP, exhaustion combatant and character, resolve_concentration, close_combat_instance, start_effect replacement, adjust_hp character, add_condition, set_suffocation character and combatant); 'S4 cascade: an effect expiry that removes the concentration owner anchors the wait at the expiry minute, whatever the partition'; Ebony Fly test. Pre-fix: 4 fail (add-on resolver unavailable on add_condition/set_suffocation/adjust_exhaustion character; cascade anchored late). Not covered by the matrix: begin_turn / round-expiry (Ring grant has no round timer) and campaign-actor owners; covered by static audit only.
Closed .12.7, .12.8, .12.9.
